name: rw-probe-t1-cradle
refs: Our approved Probe (project-owned): a hand-held field scanner standing upright, sage over sand, dark rubber foot, tall antenna, radar screen, egg window, three white plates. EDIT THIS IMAGE. Keep the device exactly as it is: its shape, size, position, colours, plates, screen and every detail.
The owner's reference for the rendering: matte painted game art.
prompt: Edit the first image only. Keep the device exactly as it is and where it is. Add a sturdy upright charging cradle that holds it standing, as a hand-held scanner is docked on a workbench: a low wide base block in the Station's sage-green moulded metal with a dark rubber top, a deep cup in the base that the device's dark rubber foot sits down into (the cup's front lip passes in front of the foot), two short side arms rising from the base that grip the device at its waist below the screen, and a slim back plate rising behind the device to just below the screen. One small unlit indicator lamp on the base front. Below the base, the top surface of a warm wooden-brown workbench seen in gentle perspective, with a soft contact shadow under the base falling to the lower right. Light: one soft key light from the top left, matte painterly rendering with soft edges, the same brushwork as the device. Keep the plain grey background above the bench. No text, no logos, no glow, no hands, no people.
